name: RPG Benchmark Scenario (RL vs A*)
description: A role-playing game benchmark scenario constructed to compare reinforcement learning and A* planning approaches, measuring performance on navigation, planning, and decision-making tasks in an interactive game setting.
reputation: Niche academic benchmark used in comparisons of RL and classical planners with limited community adoption outside research prototypes.
notes: Simulation-based, small set of scenarios focused on navigation/planning comparisons; non-LLM benchmark; risk of environment-specific overfitting and limited dataset diversity.
